title_en: Non-Adversarial Imitation Learning Provably Free of Compounding Errors: The Value Flow Mechanism
title_zh: 可证明不受复合误差影响的非对抗模仿学习：价值流动机制

sentences.en: Adversarial imitation learning (AIL) achieves high-quality imitation by mitigating compounding errors inherent to behavioral cloning (BC), yet its adversarial optimization frequently leads to training instability.
sentences.zh: 对抗模仿学习（AIL）通过缓解行为克隆（BC）固有的复合误差来实现高质量模仿，然而其对抗式优化常常导致训练不稳定。

sentences.en: A class of non-adversarial Q-based imitation learning (IL) methods, exemplified by IQ-Learn, has emerged to address this instability and is widely believed to outperform BC by leveraging online environment interactions.
sentences.zh: 以 IQ-Learn 为代表的一类基于 Q 的非对抗模仿学习（IL）方法应运而生以解决这种不稳定性，人们普遍认为它们通过利用在线环境交互能够胜过 BC。

sentences.en: In this paper, we revisit IQ-Learn and prove that it in fact reduces to BC: it admits an imitation gap lower bound with quadratic dependence on the horizon and therefore remains susceptible to compounding errors.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们重新考察 IQ-Learn，并证明它实际上退化为 BC：它的模仿间隔下界与时间跨度呈二次依赖关系，因此仍然容易受到复合误差的影响。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis reveals why online interactions fail to help: IQ-Learn uniformly suppresses Q-values for all actions at states not covered by demonstrations, preventing generalization beyond demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析揭示了为什么在线交互无济于事：IQ-Learn 在未被示范覆盖的状态下对所有动作的 Q 值进行统一抑制，从而阻碍了示范之外的泛化。

sentences.en: To address this fundamental limitation, we introduce Dual Q-DM, a new Q-based IL method built on Bellman constraints.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一根本性局限，我们提出了 Dual Q-DM，一种建立在 Bellman 约束之上的新 Q 类 IL 方法。

sentences.en: Crucially, Bellman constraints drive value flow: Q-values propagate from demonstrated to unvisited states through environment dynamics, enabling generalization beyond demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 关键的是，Bellman 约束驱动价值流动：Q 值通过环境动态从已示范状态传播到未访问状态，从而实现了示范之外的泛化。

sentences.en: We prove that Dual Q-DM is equivalent to AIL and can recover expert actions at unvisited states, thereby mitigating compounding errors.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 Dual Q-DM 与 AIL 等价，并且能够在未访问状态下恢复专家动作，从而缓解复合误差。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, Dual Q-DM is the first non-adversarial IL method that is theoretically guaranteed to eliminate compounding errors.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，Dual Q-DM 是第一个在理论上保证消除复合误差的非对抗 IL 方法。

sentences.en: Experimental results further corroborate our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 实验结果进一步印证了我们的理论发现。

title_en: Non-Euclidean Gradient Descent Operates at the Edge of Stability
title_zh: 非欧几里得梯度下降在稳定性边缘运行

sentences.en: The Edge of Stability (EoS) is a phenomenon where the sharpness (largest eigenvalue) of the Hessian converges to $2/\eta$ during training with gradient descent (GD) with a step-size $\eta$.
sentences.zh: 稳定性边缘（EoS）是这样一种现象：在使用步长为 $\eta$ 的梯度下降（GD）训练时，Hessian 的锐度（最大特征值）收敛到 $2/\eta$。

sentences.en: Despite violating classical smoothness assumptions, EoS has been widely observed in deep learning, but its theoretical foundations remain incomplete.
sentences.zh: 尽管 EoS 违反了经典的光滑性假设，它在深度学习中已被广泛观测到，但其理论基础仍不完整。

sentences.en: We propose a framework for analyzing EoS of non-Euclidean GD using directional smoothness (Mishkin et al., 2024), which naturally extends to non-Euclidean norms.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一个利用方向光滑性（Mishkin 等人，2024）分析非欧几里得 GD 的 EoS 的框架，该框架能自然地扩展到非欧几里得范数。

sentences.en: This approach allows us to characterize EoS beyond the standard Euclidean setting, encompassing methods such as $\ell_{\infty}$-descent, Block CD, Spectral GD, and Muon without momentum.
sentences.zh: 这种方法使我们能够在标准欧几里得设定之外刻画 EoS，涵盖 $\ell_{\infty}$-descent、Block CD、Spectral GD 以及无动量的 Muon 等方法。

sentences.en: We derive the appropriate measure of the generalized sharpness under an arbitrary norm.
sentences.zh: 我们推导出任意范数下广义锐度的适当度量。

sentences.en: Our generalized sharpness measure includes previously studied vanilla GD and preconditioned GD as special cases.
sentences.zh: 我们的广义锐度度量将先前研究的普通 GD 和预条件 GD 作为特例包含在内。

sentences.en: Through analytical results and experiments on neural networks, we show that non-Euclidean GD also exhibits progressive sharpening followed by oscillations around the threshold $2/\eta$.
sentences.zh: 通过解析结果和在神经网络上的实验，我们表明非欧几里得 GD 同样表现出渐进锐化，随后围绕阈值 $2/\eta$ 振荡。

sentences.en: Practically, our framework provides a single, geometry-aware spectral measure that works across optimizers, bridging the gap between empirical observations and deep learning theory.
sentences.zh: 从实用角度看，我们的框架提供了一个跨优化器通用的、具有几何感知的单一谱度量，弥合了经验观察与深度学习理论之间的差距。

title_en: Non-Monotonic Autoregressive Sequence Model
title_zh: 非单调自回归序列模型

sentences.en: Autoregressive models generate sequences monotonically, where any sampled token, even if erroneous or sub-optimal, becomes a permanent condition for all subsequent steps.
sentences.zh: 自回归模型以单调方式生成序列，任何被采样的 token，即使是有误或次优的，都会成为所有后续步骤的永久条件。

sentences.en: This structural limitation means that autoregressive models cannot revisit or revise earlier decisions, i.e., a capability essential for complex generation tasks where exploration and correction are necessary.
sentences.zh: 这种结构性局限意味着自回归模型无法重新审视或修正先前的决策，而这种能力对于需要探索和纠错的复杂生成任务至关重要。

sentences.en: To this end, we propose N-MARS, a Non-Monotonic AutoregRessive Sequence modeling framework that enables models to generate, evaluate, and revise tokens within a single forward pass, effectively allowing exploration before commitment.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出了 N-MARS，一个非单调自回归序列建模框架，它使模型能够在单次前向传播中生成、评估和修正 token，从而有效地实现在作出决定之前先进行探索。

sentences.en: We operationalize this framework through a learned erase token  that retracts the previous token, enabling on-the-fly revision within standard autoregressive decoding.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个学习得到的擦除 token 来实现这一框架，该 token 会撤销前一个 token，从而在标准自回归解码中实现即时修正。

sentences.en: To train the model, we introduce a sequence augmentation method that constructs error-correction trajectories from model-generated deviations paired with ground-truth references.
sentences.zh: 为了训练模型，我们引入了一种序列增强方法，它从模型生成的偏差与真实参考配对中构造纠错轨迹。

sentences.en: We then propose masked supervised fine-tuning (mSFT) that exposes the model to errors as context for learning when to revise, without optimizing their likelihood.
sentences.zh: 随后我们提出掩码监督微调（mSFT），它让模型将错误作为上下文来学习何时进行修正，而不去优化这些错误的似然。

sentences.en: Finally, we refine the model with group relative policy optimization (GRPO) that incentivizes judicious  usage, i.e., rewarding effective corrections while penalizing unsuccessful ones.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对模型进行精化，它激励审慎地使用（擦除 token），即对有效的修正给予奖励，同时对不成功的修正予以惩罚。

sentences.en: We conduct comprehensive theoretical and empirical analysis to validate the effectiveness of N-MARS, demonstrating a robust foundation for non-monotonic sequence modeling.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了全面的理论与实证分析以验证 N-MARS 的有效性，为非单调序列建模展示了坚实的基础。

title_en: Non-Parametric Optimization for Scalable Learning in Stochastic Decision Problems
title_zh: 随机决策问题中用于可扩展学习的非参数优化

sentences.en: Stochastic optimization (SO) plays a central role in decision-making under uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 随机优化（SO）在不确定性下的决策中发挥着核心作用。

sentences.en: Among SO problems, time-varying stochastic optimization (TV-SO) is particularly important due to its applications in adaptive control and machine learning.
sentences.zh: 在 SO 问题中，时变随机优化（TV-SO）尤为重要，因为它在自适应控制和机器学习中有广泛应用。

sentences.en: Non-parametric approaches have been proposed for time-varying deterministic optimization; however, they have not been developed for their stochastic counterparts.
sentences.zh: 针对时变确定性优化，人们已经提出了非参数方法；然而，这些方法尚未被发展到它们对应的随机版本上。

sentences.en: This work addresses that gap by developing a stochastic variational framework based on Malliavin calculus.
sentences.zh: 本工作通过开发一个基于 Malliavin 微积分的随机变分框架来填补这一空白。

sentences.en: This framework yields non-parametric optimality conditions for SO problems with stochastic decisions and supports the design of a scalable deep-learning algorithm that is insensitive to the parameterization dimension.
sentences.zh: 该框架为具有随机决策的 SO 问题提供了非参数最优性条件，并支持设计一个对参数化维度不敏感的可扩展深度学习算法。

sentences.en: This algorithm, called the Stochastic Path Follower (SPF), is applied to two important problems under distribution drift, namely least-squares recovery and logistic regression.
sentences.zh: 这一被称为随机路径追随器（SPF）的算法被应用于分布漂移下的两个重要问题，即最小二乘恢复和逻辑回归。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms state-of-the-art learning-based and gradient-based methods in both performance and scalability.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法在性能和可扩展性两方面都优于最先进的基于学习的方法和基于梯度的方法。

title_en: Non-Parametric Probabilistic Robustness: A Conservative Risk Estimator under Unknown Perturbation Distributions
title_zh: 非参数概率鲁棒性：未知扰动分布下的保守风险估计器

sentences.en: Deep learning (DL) models, despite their remarkable success, remain vulnerable to small input perturbations that can cause erroneous outputs, motivating the recent proposal of probabilistic robustness (PR) as a complementary alternative to adversarial robustness (AR).
sentences.zh: 深度学习（DL）模型尽管取得了显著成功，但对能够导致错误输出的微小输入扰动仍然很脆弱，这促使人们最近提出了概率鲁棒性（PR），作为对抗鲁棒性（AR）的一种互补替代方案。

sentences.en: However, existing PR formulations assume a fixed and known perturbation distribution, an unrealistic expectation in practice.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 PR 公式都假设扰动分布是固定且已知的，这在实践中是一种不切实际的假设。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose non-parametric probabilistic robustness (NPPR), a more practical PR metric that does not rely on any predefined perturbation distribution.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一局限，我们提出了非参数概率鲁棒性（NPPR），一种不依赖任何预定义扰动分布的更实用的 PR 指标。

sentences.en: Following the non-parametric paradigm in statistical modeling, NPPR learns an optimized perturbation distribution directly from data, enabling conservative PR evaluation under distributional uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 遵循统计模型中的非参数范式，NPPR 直接从数据中学习一个经过优化的扰动分布，从而在分布不确定性下实现保守的 PR 评估。

sentences.en: We further develop an NPPR estimator based on a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM), covering various input-dependent and input-independent perturbation scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步开发了一个基于高斯混合模型（GMM）的 NPPR 估计器，覆盖各种依赖输入和不依赖输入的扰动场景。

sentences.en: Theoretical analyses establish the relationships among AR, PR, and NPPR.
sentences.zh: 理论分析确立了 AR、PR 和 NPPR 之间的关系。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet across ResNet18/50, WideResNet50 and VGG16 validate NPPR as a more practical robustness metric, showing conservative (lower) PR estimates compared to assuming those common perturbation distributions used in state-of-the-arts.
sentences.zh: 在 ResNet18/50、WideResNet50 和 VGG16 上针对 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 Tiny ImageNet 的大量实验验证了 NPPR 是一种更实用的鲁棒性指标，与假设最先进方法所使用的常见扰动分布相比，它给出了保守（更低）的 PR 估计。

title_en: Non-Parametric Structural Priors for Geometry Theorem Prediction
title_zh: 面向几何定理预测的非参数结构先验

sentences.en: Multi-step theorem prediction is a central challenge in geometry problem solving.
sentences.zh: 多步定理预测是几何问题求解中的核心挑战。

sentences.en: Existing neural–symbolic approaches rely heavily on supervised parametric models, which exhibit limited generalization to evolving theorem libraries.
sentences.zh: 现有的神经-符号方法严重依赖有监督的参数化模型，而这些模型对不断演化的定理库表现出有限的泛化能力。

sentences.en: In this work, we explore training-free theorem prediction through the lens of in-context learning (ICL).
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们通过上下文学习（ICL）的视角探索免训练的定理预测。

sentences.en: We identify a critical scalability bottleneck, termed Structural Drift: as reasoning depth increases, the performance of vanilla ICL degrades sharply.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出一个关键的扩展性瓶颈，称为结构漂移（Structural Drift）：随着推理深度的增加，普通 ICL 的性能急剧下降。

sentences.en: We attribute this to the LLM’s inability to recover latent topological dependencies, leading to unstructured exploration.
sentences.zh: 我们将此归因于大语言模型（LLM）无法恢复潜在的拓扑依赖关系，从而导致了无结构的探索。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose Theorem Precedence Graphs, which encode temporal dependencies from historical solution traces as directed graphs, and impose explicit topological constraints that effectively prune the search space during inference.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一问题，我们提出了定理先序图（Theorem Precedence Graphs），它将历史解题轨迹中的时序依赖编码为有向图，并施加显式的拓扑约束，从而在推理过程中有效地剪枝搜索空间。

sentences.en: Coupled with retrieval-augmented graph construction and a stepwise symbolic executor, our approach enables LLMs to act as structured planners without any gradient-based optimization.
sentences.zh: 结合检索增强的图构建和逐步符号执行器，我们的方法使 LLM 能够无需任何基于梯度的优化即可充当结构化规划器。

sentences.en: Experiments on the FormalGeo7k benchmark show that our method achieves 89.29\% accuracy, substantially outperforming ICL baselines and matching state-of-the-art supervised models.
sentences.zh: 在 FormalGeo7k 基准上的实验表明，我们的方法达到了 89.29\% 的准确率，大幅超越 ICL 基线，并与最先进的监督模型相当。

sentences.en: These results indicate that explicit structural priors offer a promising direction for scaling LLM-based symbolic reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，显式的结构先验为扩展基于 LLM 的符号推理提供了一个有前景的方向。

title_en: Non-Stationary Online Structured Prediction with Surrogate Losses
title_zh: 基于代理损失的非平稳在线结构化预测

sentences.en: Online structured prediction, including online classification as a special case, is the task of sequentially predicting labels from input features.
sentences.zh: 在线结构化预测（包括作为其特例的在线分类）是从输入特征中逐次预测标签的任务。

sentences.en: In this setting, the *surrogate regret*—the cumulative excess of the actual target loss (e.g., the 0-1 loss) over the surrogate loss (e.g., the logistic loss) incurred by the best fixed estimator—has gained attention because it admits a finite bound independent of the time horizon $T$.
sentences.zh: 在这一设定下，*代理遗憾*——即最佳固定估计器所产生的实际目标损失（例如 0-1 损失）超出代理损失（例如逻辑损失）的累积量——受到了关注，因为它有一个与时间跨度 $T$ 无关的有限上界。

sentences.en: However, such guarantees break down in *non-stationary* environments, where every fixed estimator may incur surrogate loss that grows linearly with $T$.
sentences.zh: 然而，在*非平稳*环境中，这类保证会失效，因为任何固定估计器都可能产生随 $T$ 线性增长的代理损失。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we obtain an upper bound of $F_T+O(1+P_T)$ on the cumulative target loss, where $F_T$ is the cumulative surrogate loss of any comparator sequence and $P_T$ is its *path length*.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这一限制，我们得到了累积目标损失的上界 $F_T+O(1+P_T)$，其中 $F_T$ 是任意比较序列的累积代理损失，$P_T$ 是其*路径长度*。

sentences.en: This bound depends on $T$ only through $F_T$ and $P_T$, thus offering stronger guarantees under non-stationarity.
sentences.zh: 这个上界对 $T$ 的依赖仅通过 $F_T$ 和 $P_T$ 实现，因此在非平稳性下提供更强的保证。

sentences.en: Our core idea is to combine the dynamic regret analysis of online gradient descent (OGD) with the *exploit-the-surrogate-gap* technique.
sentences.zh: 我们的核心思想是将在线梯度下降（OGD）的动态遗憾分析与*利用代理差距*技术相结合。

sentences.en: This viewpoint sheds light on the usefulness of a Polyak-style learning rate for OGD, which systematically yields target-loss bounds and performs well empirically.
sentences.zh: 这一视角揭示了 Polyak 式学习率对 OGD 的用处，它能系统地给出目标损失上界，并且在经验上表现良好。

sentences.en: We then extend our approach to broader settings beyond prior work via the *convolutional Fenchel–Young loss*.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们通过*卷积 Fenchel–Young 损失*，将我们的方法扩展到超越先前工作的更广泛设定。

sentences.en: Finally, a lower bound shows that the dependence on $F_T$ and $P_T$ is tight.
sentences.zh: 最后，一个下界表明对 $F_T$ 和 $P_T$ 的依赖是紧的。

title_en: Non-Uniform Noise-to-Signal Ratio in the REINFORCE Policy-Gradient Estimator
title_zh: REINFORCE 策略梯度估计器中的非均匀噪声-信号比

sentences.en: Policy-gradient methods are widely used in reinforcement learning, yet training often becomes unstable or slows down as learning progresses.
sentences.zh: 策略梯度方法在强化学习中被广泛使用，然而随着学习的进行，训练常常变得不稳定或变慢。

sentences.en: We study this phenomenon through the **noise-to-signal ratio** (NSR) of a policy-gradient estimator, defined as the estimator variance (noise) normalized by the squared norm of the true gradient (signal).
sentences.zh: 我们通过策略梯度估计器的**噪声-信号比**（NSR）来研究这一现象，该比值定义为估计器方差（噪声）除以真实梯度的范数平方（信号）。

sentences.en: Our main result is that, for (i) finite-horizon linear systems with Gaussian policies and linear state-feedback, and (ii) finite-horizon polynomial systems with Gaussian policies and polynomial feedback, the NSR of the REINFORCE estimator can be characterized exactly—either in closed form or via numerical moment-evaluation algorithms—without approximation.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要结果是：对于 (i) 具有高斯策略和线性状态反馈的有限时域线性系统，以及 (ii) 具有高斯策略和多项式反馈的有限时域多项式系统，REINFORCE 估计器的 NSR 可以被精确刻画——无论是闭式表示还是通过数值矩评估算法——且无需任何近似。

sentences.en: For general nonlinear dynamics and expressive policies (including neural policies), we further derive a general upper bound on the variance.
sentences.zh: 对于一般的非线性动力学和具有表现力的策略（包括神经策略），我们进一步推导出方差的一般上界。

sentences.en: These characterizations enable a direct examination of how NSR varies across policy parameters and how it evolves along optimization trajectories (e.g. SGD and Adam).
sentences.zh: 这些刻画使得我们能够直接考察 NSR 如何随策略参数变化，以及它如何沿着优化轨迹（例如 SGD 和 Adam）演化。

sentences.en: Across a range of examples, we find that the NSR landscape is highly non-uniform and typically increases as the policy approaches an optimum; in some regimes it blows up, which can trigger training instability and policy collapse.
sentences.zh: 在一系列示例中，我们发现 NSR 的分布地形高度非均匀，并且通常随着策略接近最优值而增大；在某些情况下它会爆炸性地增长，这可能会引发训练不稳定和策略崩溃。

title_en: Nonconvex Low-Rank Tensor Representation with Deep Priors for Multiview Subspace Clustering
title_zh: 带深度先验的非凸低秩张量表示用于多视图子空间聚类

sentences.en: Multiview subspace clustering (MvSC) has shown remarkable potential in exploring underlying structures of high-dimensional data.
sentences.zh: 多视图子空间聚类（MvSC）在探索高维数据的底层结构方面展现出了非凡的潜力。

sentences.en: However, existing MvSC methods still suffer from two shortcomings: (1) the commonly use of convex low-rank approximations inadequately capture high-order correlations across views, while sensitivity to noise and outliers degrades clustering performance, and (2) they lack the ability to preserve global correlations and local geometric patterns simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 MvSC 方法仍存在两个缺点：(1) 常用的凸低秩近似无法充分捕捉跨视图的高阶相关性，同时对噪声和离群点的敏感会损害聚类性能；(2) 它们缺乏同时保留全局相关性与局部几何模式的能力。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose a novel nonconvex regularized MvSC model with deep prior, which not only accurately characterizes  the intrinsic low-rank structure and suppresses the effect of outliers, but also preserves local structural properties through deep networks.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种带深度先验的新型非凸正则化 MvSC 模型，它不仅能够精确刻画内在的低秩结构并抑制离群点的影响，还能通过深度网络保留局部结构特性。

sentences.en: By mathematically analyzing the optimal solution of the optimization problem in our proposed model, we develop an efficient ADMM-based algorithm with provable convergence guarantees to solve it.
sentences.zh: 通过对我们提出模型中优化问题的最优解进行数学分析，我们开发了一种基于 ADMM 的高效求解算法，并具有可证明的收敛保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on various datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed model.
sentences.zh: 在多种数据集上进行的大量实验证明了所提出模型的优越性。

title_en: Nonlinear Covariate Balance in Experimental Design
title_zh: 实验设计中的非线性协变量平衡

sentences.en: We study experimental designs that balance nonlinear functions of covariates, extending classical methods that primarily target linear balance.
sentences.zh: 我们研究使协变量的非线性函数达到平衡的实验设计，扩展了主要针对线性平衡的经典方法。

sentences.en: Building on the Gram-Schmidt Walk (GSW) framework of Harshaw et al (2024) for linear covariate balancing, we introduce a design that directly controls imbalance in nonlinear structure, including polynomial and more general smooth function classes.
sentences.zh: 在 Harshaw 等人（2024）用于线性协变量平衡的 Gram-Schmidt Walk（GSW）框架基础上，我们提出了一种直接控制非线性结构中不平衡的设计，涵盖多项式函数类以及更一般的平滑函数类。

sentences.en: Like GSW, the proposed design retains sufficient robustness against model misspecification.
sentences.zh: 与 GSW 一样，所提出的设计对模型误设保持了足够的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: Our implementation operates directly on a Gram matrix, avoiding the expensive step of explicitly constructing the nonlinear covariate expansions.
sentences.zh: 我们的实现直接作用于 Gram 矩阵，避免了显式构造非线性协变量展开这一昂贵的步骤。

sentences.en: We further accelerate the nonlinear design via a low-rank approximation of the Gram matrix, achieving runtimes comparable to the GSW of Harshaw et al (2024) while preserving nonlinear covariate balance and robustness.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步通过 Gram 矩阵的低秩近似来加速非线性设计，在保持非线性协变量平衡和鲁棒性的同时，实现了与 Harshaw 等人（2024）的 GSW 相当的运行时间。

title_en: Nonparametric Data Attribution for Diffusion Models
title_zh: 扩散模型的非参数数据归因

sentences.en: Data attribution for generative models seeks to quantify the influence of individual training examples on model outputs.
sentences.zh: 生成模型的数据归因旨在量化单个训练样本对模型输出的影响。

sentences.en: Existing methods for diffusion models typically require access to model gradients or retraining, limiting their applicability in proprietary or large-scale settings.
sentences.zh: 现有的扩散模型归因方法通常需要访问模型梯度或进行重新训练，这限制了它们在专有或大规模场景中的适用性。

sentences.en: We propose a *nonparametric* attribution method that operates directly on data, measuring influence via patch-level similarity between generated and training images.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一种直接作用于数据本身的*非参数*归因方法，通过生成图像与训练图像之间的 patch 级相似度来衡量影响。

sentences.en: Our approach is grounded in the analytical form of the optimal score function, extends naturally to multiscale representations, and remains computationally efficient through convolution-based acceleration.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法以最优分数函数的解析形式为理论基础，能够自然地扩展到多尺度表示，并通过基于卷积的加速保持计算高效。

sentences.en: In addition to producing spatially interpretable attributions, our framework uncovers patch-level correspondences between training data and generated outputs.
sentences.zh: 除了产生具有空间可解释性的归因之外，我们的框架还揭示了训练数据与生成输出之间的 patch 级对应关系。

sentences.en: Experiments show that NDA substantially outperforms existing nonparametric baselines and achieves the best attribution performance among the evaluated methods that do not use target-model parameters or gradients.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，NDA 大幅优于现有的非参数基线，并在所有不使用目标模型参数或梯度的方法中取得了最佳的归因性能。

title_en: Nonparametric Distribution Regression Re-calibration
title_zh: 非参数分布回归重校准

sentences.en: A key challenge in probabilistic regression is ensuring that predictive distributions accurately reflect true empirical uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 概率回归中的一个关键挑战是确保预测分布能够准确反映真实的经验不确定性。

sentences.en: Minimizing overall prediction error often encourages models to prioritize informativeness over calibration, producing narrow but overconfident predictions.
sentences.zh: 最小化整体预测误差往往会使模型优先追求信息量而非校准性，从而产生狭窄但过度自信的预测。

sentences.en: However, in safety-critical settings, trustworthy uncertainty estimates are often more valuable than narrow intervals.
sentences.zh: 然而，在安全关键的场景中，可信的不确定性估计往往比狭窄的区间更有价值。

sentences.en: Realizing the problem, several recent works have focused on post-hoc corrections; however, existing methods either rely on weak notions of calibration (such as PIT uniformity) or impose restrictive parametric assumptions on the nature of the error.
sentences.zh: 意识到这个问题后，近期的若干工作聚焦于事后校正；然而，现有方法要么依赖较弱的校准概念（例如 PIT 均匀性），要么对误差的性质施加了限制性的参数假设。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we propose a novel nonparametric re-calibration algorithm based on conditional kernel mean embeddings, capable of correcting calibration error without restrictive modeling assumptions.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些局限，我们提出了一种基于条件核均值嵌入的新型非参数重校准算法，它能够在无需限制性建模假设的情况下校正校准误差。

sentences.en: For efficient inference with real-valued targets, we introduce a novel characteristic kernel over distributions that can be evaluated in $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ time for empirical distributions of size $n$.
sentences.zh: 为了实现实值目标的高效推理，我们引入了一种新颖的分布上的特征核，对于规模为 $n$ 的经验分布，它可以在 $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ 时间内完成计算。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms prior re-calibration approaches across a diverse set of regression benchmarks and model classes.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在多种回归基准和模型类上，我们的方法始终优于先前的重校准方法。

authors.name: Andras Benczur
authors.institution: Institute for Computer Science and Control, Hungary

title_en: Nonparametric LLM Evaluation from Preference Data
title_zh: 基于偏好数据的非参数 LLM 评估

sentences.en: Evaluating the performance of large language models (LLMs) from human preference data is crucial for obtaining LLM leaderboards.
sentences.zh: 从人类偏好数据评估大语言模型（LLM）的性能，对于构建 LLM 排行榜至关重要。

sentences.en: However, many existing approaches either rely on restrictive parametric assumptions or lack valid uncertainty quantification when flexible machine learning methods are used.
sentences.zh: 然而，许多现有方法要么依赖限制性的参数假设，要么在使用灵活的机器学习方法时缺乏有效的不确定性量化。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a nonparametric statistical framework, called DMLRank, for comparing and ranking LLMs from preference data using debiased machine learning (DML).
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个名为 DMLRank 的非参数统计框架，利用去偏机器学习（DML）从偏好数据中对 LLM 进行比较和排名。

sentences.en: For this, we introduce generalized average ranking scores (GARS), which generalize commonly used ranking models, including the Bradley-Terry model or PageRank/ Rank centrality with complex human responses such as ties.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入了广义平均排名分数（GARS），它推广了常用的排名模型，包括 Bradley-Terry 模型或 PageRank/ Rank centrality，并能处理平局等复杂的人类响应。

sentences.en: DMLRank comes with the following advantages: (i) It produces statistically efficient estimates of GARS ranking scores.
sentences.zh: DMLRank 具有以下优点：(i) 它能产生具有统计效率的 GARS 排名分数估计。

sentences.en: (ii) It naturally allows to incorporate black-box machine learning methods for estimation.
sentences.zh: (ii) 它能自然地整合黑盒机器学习方法用于估计。

sentences.en: (iii) It can be combined with pre-trained LLM evaluators (e.g., using LLM-as-a-judge).
sentences.zh: (iii) 它可以与预训练的 LLM 评估器结合（例如使用 LLM-as-a-judge）。

sentences.en: (iv) It suggests optimal policies for collecting preference data under budget constraints.
sentences.zh: (iv) 它能为在预算约束下收集偏好数据提出最优策略。

sentences.en: We demonstrate these advantages both theoretically and empirically using both synthetic and real-world preference datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们同时使用合成偏好数据集和真实世界偏好数据集，从理论和实证两方面展示了这些优点。

sentences.en: In summary, our framework provides practitioners with powerful, state-of-the-art methods for comparing or ranking LLMs for leaderboards.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们的框架为从业者提供了强大且最先进的方法，用于在排行榜场景中比较或排名 LLM。

title_en: NonZero: Interaction-Guided Exploration for Multi-Agent Monte Carlo Tree Search
title_zh: NonZero：面向多智能体蒙特卡洛树搜索的交互引导探索

sentences.en: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) scales poorly in cooperative multi-agent domains because expansion must consider an exponentially large set of joint actions, severely limiting exploration under realistic search budgets.
sentences.zh: 蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）在协作式多智能体领域中的扩展性很差，因为扩展时必须考虑指数级大的联合动作集合，这严重限制了在现实搜索预算下的探索。

sentences.en: We propose \textsc{NonZero}, which keeps multi-agent MCTS tractable by running surrogate-guided selection over a low-dimensional nonlinear representation using an interaction-guided proposal rule, instead of directly exploring the full joint-action space.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 \textsc{NonZero}，它通过使用交互引导的提议规则，在低维非线性表示上进行代理引导的选择，而非直接探索完整的联合动作空间，从而使多智能体 MCTS 保持可处理性。

sentences.en: Our exploration uses an interaction score: single-agent deviations are ranked by predicted gain, while two-agent deviations are scored by a mixed-difference measure that reveals coordination benefits even when no single agent can improve alone.
sentences.zh: 我们的探索使用一种交互分数：单智能体偏差按预测增益进行排名，而双智能体偏差则用一种混合差异度量来打分，即便没有任何单个智能体能单独改善，该度量也能揭示协调带来的收益。

sentences.en: We formalize candidate proposal as a bandit problem over local deviations and derive a proposal rule, \textsc{NonUCT}, with a sublinear local-regret guarantee for reaching approximate graph-local optima without enumerating the joint-action space.
sentences.zh: 我们将候选提议形式化为一个关于局部偏差的赌博机问题，并推导出一个提议规则 \textsc{NonUCT}，它在无需枚举联合动作空间的情况下，给出了达到近似图局部最优解的次线性局部遗憾保证。

sentences.en: Empirically, \textsc{NonZero} improves sample efficiency and final performance on MatGame, SMAC, and SMACv2 relative to strong model-based and model-free baselines under matched search budgets.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，在相同的搜索预算下，与强大的基于模型和无模型基线相比，\textsc{NonZero} 在 MatGame、SMAC 和 SMACv2 上提升了样本效率与最终性能。

title_en: Norm$\times$Direction: Restoring the Missing Query Norm in Vision Linear Attention
title_zh: Norm$\times$Direction：恢复视觉线性注意力中缺失的查询范数

sentences.en: Linear attention mitigates the quadratic complexity of softmax attention but suffers from a critical loss of expressiveness.
sentences.zh: 线性注意力缓解了 softmax 注意力的二次复杂度，但遭受了严重的表达力损失。

sentences.en: We identify two primary causes: (1) The normalization operation cancels the query norm, which breaks the correlation between a query's norm and the spikiness (entropy) of the attention distribution as in softmax attention.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出两个主要原因：(1) 归一化操作消去了查询范数，从而破坏了查询范数与注意力分布尖峰度（熵）之间的相关性——而在 softmax 注意力中这种相关性是存在的。

sentences.en: (2) Standard techniques for enforcing non-negativity cause destructive information loss by nullifying valid inner-product interactions.
sentences.zh: (2) 用于强制非负性的标准技术通过使有效的内积交互失效，造成了破坏性的信息损失。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we introduce **NaLaFormer**, a novel linear attention mechanism built upon a norm$\times$direction (ND) decomposition of the query and key vectors.
sentences.zh: 为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了 **NaLaFormer**，一种建立在查询和键向量的 norm$\times$direction（ND）分解之上的新型线性注意力机制。

sentences.en: We leverage each component to solve a distinct problem: The *query norm* is injected into our kernel to create a query-norm-aware map that restores the attention distribution's spikiness.
sentences.zh: 我们利用每个分量来解决不同的问题：*查询范数*被注入我们的核函数，以创建一个感知查询范数的映射，从而恢复注意力分布的尖峰度。

sentences.en: The *direction vectors* are processed by a geometric, cosine-based similarity metric that guarantees non-negativity while preserving the rich, fine-grained information of the inner product.
sentences.zh: *方向向量*则由一种基于余弦的几何相似度度量来处理，该度量在保留内积丰富且细粒度信息的同时保证了非负性。

sentences.en: We validate NaLaFormer through a comprehensive multi-modal evaluation, where it sets new state-of-the-art benchmarks for linear attention.
sentences.zh: 我们通过全面的多模态评估来验证 NaLaFormer，它在此过程中为线性注意力树立了新的最先进基准。

sentences.en: Our model achieves up to a 7.5\% accuracy gain on ImageNet-1K and a 4.7\% mIoU improvement on ADE20K over comparable baselines.
sentences.zh: 与同类基线相比，我们的模型在 ImageNet-1K 上实现了高达 7.5\% 的准确率提升，在 ADE20K 上实现了 4.7\% 的 mIoU 改进。

sentences.en: It demonstrates profound efficiency, reducing peak memory by a transformative 92.3\% in token-intensive super-resolution tasks (70K+ tokens).
sentences.zh: 它展现出极高的效率，在 token 密集型超分辨率任务（7 万以上 token）中将峰值内存显著降低了 92.3\%。

sentences.en: NaLaFormer's versatility is further confirmed as it surpasses strong baselines like Mamba on common-sense reasoning and sets a new state-of-the-art on the Long Range Arena (LRA) benchmark.
sentences.zh: NaLaFormer 的多功能性得到进一步证实：它在常识推理上超越了 Mamba 等强大基线，并在 Long Range Arena（LRA）基准上树立了新的最先进水平。

sentences.en: Source code can be found in the supplementary materials.
sentences.zh: 源代码可在补充材料中找到。

title_en: Normality Calibration in Semi-supervised Graph Anomaly Detection
title_zh: 半监督图异常检测中的常态性校准

sentences.en: Semi-supervised graph anomaly detection (GAD), which assumes a subset of labeled normal nodes for training, is widely studied.
sentences.zh: 半监督图异常检测（GAD）假定训练时使用一部分有标签的正常节点，已被广泛研究。

sentences.en: However, existing methods learn normality only from these labeled nodes, often overfitting their patterns and causing high detection errors, such as many false positives.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法仅从这些有标签节点学习常态性，常常会过拟合它们的模式，导致较高的检测错误，例如大量误报。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose $GraphNC$, a graph normality calibration framework that leverages both labeled and unlabeled data to calibrate the normality from a teacher (a pre-trained semi-supervised GAD model) jointly in anomaly score and representation spaces.
sentences.zh: 为了克服这一局限，我们提出了 $GraphNC$，一个图常态性校准框架，它利用有标签和无标签数据，在异常分数空间和表示空间中联合地对来自教师模型（一个预训练的半监督 GAD 模型）的常态性进行校准。

sentences.en: GraphNC includes two main components, anomaly score distribution alignment ($ScoreDA$) and perturbation-based normality regularization ($NormReg$).
sentences.zh: GraphNC 包含两个主要组成部分：异常分数分布对齐（$ScoreDA$）和基于扰动的常态性正则化（$NormReg$）。

sentences.en: ScoreDA optimizes our model’s anomaly scores by aligning them with the teacher’s score distribution.
sentences.zh: ScoreDA 通过将我们模型的异常分数与教师模型的分数分布对齐来优化这些分数。

sentences.en: Because the teacher provides accurate scores for most normal nodes and some anomalies, this alignment pulls the scores of the two classes toward opposite ends, making them more separable.
sentences.zh: 因为教师模型为大多数正常节点和部分异常节点提供了准确的分数，这种对齐会将两类的分数推向相反两端，使它们更易分离。

sentences.en: To reduce the impact of inaccurate teacher scores, NormReg regularizes normality in the representation space, making normal node representations more compact via a perturbation-guided consistency loss applied only to the labeled nodes.
sentences.zh: 为了减少不准确教师分数的影响，NormReg 在表示空间中对常态性进行正则化，通过一种仅应用于有标签节点的扰动引导一致性损失，使正常节点的表示更加紧凑。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that GraphNC (1) consistently and substantially enhances the performance of teacher models from different GAD methods (2) achieves new state-of-the-art performance.
sentences.zh: 在六个基准上的全面实验表明，GraphNC (1) 一致且显著地提升了来自不同 GAD 方法的教师模型的性能，(2) 达到了新的最先进性能水平。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/mala-lab/GraphNC.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/mala-lab/GraphNC 获取。

title_en: Normalization Equivariance for Arbitrary Backbones, with Application to Image Denoising
title_zh: 任意主干网络的归一化等变性及其在图像去噪中的应用

sentences.en: Normalization Equivariance (NE) is a structural prior that improves robustness to distribution shift in image-to-image tasks.
sentences.zh: 归一化等变性（NE）是一种结构先验，能够提升图像到图像任务中对分布偏移的鲁棒性。

sentences.en: A function $f$ is normalization equivariant iff $f(a y + b\mathbf{1}) = a f(y) + b\mathbf{1}$ for all $a>0$ and $b\in\mathbb{R}$.
sentences.zh: 当且仅当对所有 $a>0$ 和 $b\in\mathbb{R}$ 都有 $f(a y + b\mathbf{1}) = a f(y) + b\mathbf{1}$ 时，函数 $f$ 才是归一化等变的。

sentences.en: Existing NE methods constrain every internal layer to NE-compatible operations.
sentences.zh: 现有的 NE 方法将每个内部层都限制为与 NE 兼容的操作。

sentences.en: These constraints add runtime cost and exclude standard transformer components such as softmax attention and LayerNorm.
sentences.zh: 这些约束增加了运行开销，并排除了 softmax 注意力和 LayerNorm 等标准 transformer 组件。

sentences.en: We introduce Wrapped Normalization Equivariance (WNE), a parameter-free wrapper that normalizes the input, applies any backbone, and denormalizes the output.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了包裹式归一化等变性（WNE），一种无参数的包装器，它对输入进行归一化、应用任意主干网络，再对输出进行反归一化。

sentences.en: We prove every NE function admits this factorization, so the wrapper exactly parameterizes the class of NE functions.
sentences.zh: 我们证明每个 NE 函数都允许这种分解，因此该包装器精确地参数化了 NE 函数的类别。

sentences.en: On blind denoising, wrapping CNN and transformer architectures improves robustness under noise-level mismatch with no measurable GPU overhead, while architectural NE baselines are up to $1.6\times$ slower.
sentences.zh: 在盲去噪任务上，包裹 CNN 和 transformer 架构能在噪声水平失配下提升鲁棒性，且没有可测量的 GPU 额外开销，而架构级 NE 基线则慢达 $1.6\times$。

title_en: Normalization-equivariant Diffusion Models: Learning Posterior Samplers From Noisy And Partial Measurements
title_zh: 归一化等变扩散模型：从带噪声和部分测量中学习后验采样器

sentences.en: Diffusion models (DMs) are a powerful framework for image generation and restoration.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型（DM）是用于图像生成与恢复的强大框架。

sentences.en: However, existing DMs are primarily trained in a supervised manner by using a large corpus of clean images.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的 DM 主要通过使用大量干净图像语料进行监督式训练。

sentences.en: This poses fundamental challenges in many real-world scenarios, where acquiring noise-free data is hard or infeasible.
sentences.zh: 这在许多真实世界场景中构成了根本性挑战，因为在这些场景中获取无噪声数据是困难甚至不可行的。

sentences.en: While some methods are capable of training DMs using noisy data, they are effective only when the amount of noise is very mild or when additional noise-free data is available.
sentences.zh: 虽然有些方法能够使用带噪声的数据训练 DM，但它们只在噪声非常轻微，或者有额外无噪声数据可用时才有效。

sentences.en: In addition, existing methods for training DMs from incomplete measurements require access to multiple complementary acquisition processes, a significant practical limitation.
sentences.zh: 此外，现有从不完整测量中训练 DM 的方法需要访问多个互补的采集过程，这是一个重要的实际限制。

sentences.en: Here we introduce the first approach for learning DMs for image restoration using only noisy measurement data from a single operator.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们引入了第一种仅使用来自单个算子（operator）的带噪声测量数据来学习用于图像恢复的 DM 的方法。

sentences.en: First, we show that DMs, and more broadly minimum mean squared error denoisers, exhibit a weak form of scale equivariance linking rescaling in signal amplitude to changes in noise intensity.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们证明 DM，以及更广泛的最小均方误差去噪器，表现出一种弱形式的尺度等变性，它将信号幅度的重新缩放与噪声强度的变化联系起来。

sentences.en: We then leverage this theoretical insight to develop a denoising score-matching strategy that generalizes robustly to noise levels below the training data, thereby enabling the learning of DMs from noisy measurements.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们利用这一理论洞见，开发了一种去噪分数匹配策略，它能稳健地泛化到低于训练数据的噪声水平，从而使得能够从带噪声测量中学习 DM。

sentences.en: For problems involving measurements both noisy and incomplete, we integrate our method with equivariant imaging, a complementary self-supervised learning framework that exploits the inherent invariants of imaging problems.
sentences.zh: 对于同时涉及带噪声和部分测量的测量问题，我们将我们的方法与等变成像（equivariant imaging）相结合，这是一种利用成像问题固有不变性的互补自监督学习框架。

sentences.en: This allows training DMs for image restoration from single-operator noisy measurements.
sentences.zh: 这使得能够从单算子带噪声测量中训练用于图像恢复的 DM。

sentences.en: We validate the effectiveness of our approach through extensive experiments on image denoising, demosaicing, inpainting, and MRI reconstruction along with comparisons with the state of the art.
sentences.zh: 我们通过在图像去噪、去马赛克、修复和 MRI 重建上的大量实验，并与最先进方法进行比较，验证了我们方法的有效性。
